heading: Atom framing
text:
## Atom framing [RDSC.2]

Framing is protobuf-native and two levels: a container is a `Dsc` or a `Stream`
holding `repeated Atom atoms = 1`, the outer frame is `[0x0A][varint len][Atom]`
and the inner `Atom` is `[oneof_tag][varint len][body]` ([RFCS.19.1]). An atom is
identified by its `oneof` field number, never by a name ([RFCS.16.1]).
